Name: Elliott's Less Ugly House
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][u][b][i]Elliott's Less Ugly House[/i][/b]

[/u][/size][size=4][i][b]Please check the original mod [/b][/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11569][i][b]Here!
[/b][/i][/url][b][i]Thank you to ﻿[/i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/135930628?tab=user+files]Luan125gui[/url] for giving me permission to republish their mod with my edit![/i]
[/b][/size]
[size=3]A very simple mod with a fairly long description.
[/size]
[size=3]Our local aspirant novelist looks to be living in the backrooms, so I took it upon myself to wreck his home with a little more [i]aesthetics[b]. 
[/b][/i]Edited from their amazing [url=http://]mod[/url], I only did a few minor edits and a little bit of sledgehammer work to make Elliot's cabin reflect his canon living condition!

[i][u][color=#ea9999][size=5]NEW!! 1.0.4[/size][/color]

[/u][/i][list]
[*][size=3]Added an [u][color=#a4c2f4][b]Optional[/b][/color][/u] version - It's got a new design + the piano is recolor friendly. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM![/url][/size]
[*]Added a new dependency, now needs EML or EML for Android if you're on mobile!
[/list][/size]
[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][b]AFTER[/b][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted!
[/size][size=1][b](Sidenote, you can see in the screenshot that Elliot's piano isn't recolored properly. This is because that is a custom tilesheet.)[/b][/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size]


[size=5][u][b][i][color=#ff0000]Very Important, Read me![/color][/i][/b]

[/u]What this mod [u][b][color=#ff0000]DOESN'T[/color][/b][/u] do:[/size]

[b][size=4][s]1. Add a night time version[/s][/size]
[/b]
[size=3][size=3]Learned how to do that, no more eternal sunlight :(([/size][/size]

[size=4][b]2. Edits the Heart events[/b]

[/size][size=3]I made this mod with the VANILLA heart events in mind, so It should work fine with Elliott's normal cutscenes.

[s]It should work with those that doesn't do anything with Elliott's Cabin Interior, but I'd imagine it doesn't fare well with those that does. 
I know there's a lot of mods out there that adds more cutscenes/heart events to Elliott, I just really can't test them all. If ever you are in a modded cutscene with him and somehow get stuck in the middle, just simply skip the cutscene.

Yes, not very immersive, but nothing much I can do about. Just think of it as your character going into a sudden comatose from Elliott's glorious poshness.[/s]

As of update 1.0.4, the [color=#a4c2f4][b][u]Optional[/u][/b][/color] version should work with any custom cutscenes.[/size][size=3]


[/size][size=5][u][b][i]Compatibilities[/i][/b][/u][/size]

[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]East Scarp[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=3]don't know if it adds cutscenes inside Elliott's home, but it should be fine.[/size]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]RidgeSide Village[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=3]still don't know if it adds cutscenes too, but it should also be fine.[/size]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=3]surprisingly, yes.[/size]
[u][b][color=#00ff00][size=4]Elliott Expansion Mods[/size][/color][/b][/u][size=4], [/size][size=3]should be alright. Use the [b][u][color=#a4c2f4]Optional[/color][/u][/b] version if you have any issues.[/size]

[u][size=5][b][i]Installation[/i][/b]

2. Download this mod
3. Extract the zip into your mods folder 
4. Viola![/size][/font]
